name: Guard

name: Bandit

actions.text: Melee Attack: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 slashing.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320, 1d8+1 piercing.

tactics: Wants loot, not death. Breaks when half the gang is down.

name: Cultist

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.text: Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Attack: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 slashing.

tactics: Fights to the death to protect a leader or ritual.

name: Goblin

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.text: Can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Scimitar

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320, 1d6+2 piercing.

tactics: Surrounds an isolated target; flees when the pack is thinned.

name: Skeleton

traits.text: Vulnerable to bludgeoning damage; immune to poison and exhaustion.

actions.text: Ranged Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320, 1d6+2 piercing.

tactics: Follows its last orders literally; never retreats.

name: Zombie

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: When reduced to 0 HP by non-radiant, non-critical damage, makes a DC 5 + damage Constitution save to drop to 1 HP instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 bludgeoning.

tactics: Shambles at the nearest living creature.

actions.text: Ranged Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600, 1d8+1 piercing.

tactics: Disciplined: shield wall, focus fire, orderly withdrawal.

traits.name: Aggressive

traits.name: Nimble Escape

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Attack: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

actions.text: Melee Attack: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing; DC 13 Strength save or knocked prone.

tactics: Webs the biggest threat, bites the restrained.
